instance.settings_hash_definition: sha256 of UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON of settings

funding_targets.post-chronicle: 200 or a later tip of the same era
funding_targets.pre-genesis: none: no coinbase output matures below height 100; undecided

mapping.outpoints: rebound, locking scripts and values preserved; signature and absolute-height/time rows excluded
mapping.spend_height: confirmed funding height + 1; actual chain tip + 1

paths.block: node ValidatorAPI.ValidateTransaction, SkipPolicyChecks=true, InBlock=true, parents read from its store; full block-wrapper acceptance is not inferred
paths.mempool: node sendrawtransaction under its recorded test settings

provenance: synthetic seed corpus; node at the tagged pin on the local private chain; witnesses are unclassified findings
